description: This file contains functions and types for handling attachments in the BlueBubbles messaging app, including downloading media, sending attachments, and handling voice message specifics.

methods.name: blueBubblesPolicy
methods.description: Creates SSRF policy object based on allowPrivateNetwork flag.

methods.name: sanitizeFilename
methods.description: Sanitizes filename to prevent header injection and trims input.

methods.name: ensureExtension
methods.description: Ensures filename has the specified extension, adding it if missing.

methods.name: resolveVoiceInfo
methods.description: Determines if a filename/contentType corresponds to an audio file (mp3 or caf).

methods.name: resolveAccount
methods.description: Resolves server account details from options.

methods.name: safeExtractHostname
methods.description: Extracts hostname from URL safely, returning undefined on error.

methods.name: readMediaFetchErrorCode
methods.description: Interprets error object to identify specific media fetch error codes.

methods.name: downloadBlueBubblesAttachment
methods.description: Downloads media attachment from BlueBubbles server, respecting maxBytes limit.

methods.name: sendBlueBubblesAttachment
methods.description: Sends media attachment via BlueBubbles API, supporting voice memos and reply threading.
